topics.title: Values, names, control flow, and functions
topics.why: Programs need a clear way to store decisions and repeat work.
topics.explanation: Names point to values; expressions calculate; control flow selects and repeats; functions package behavior.
topics.analogy: A function is a labelled recipe you can use again.
topics.exampleNote: Return sends a value back to the caller.
topics.underHood: The interpreter evaluates expressions and keeps names in namespaces.
topics.summary: Values, flow, and functions are the core building blocks.

options: Sends a value to the caller
quiz.explanation: return finishes a function call and supplies its result.

labs.title: Predict output
labs.task: Create a function that returns a greeting.
labs.test: Hidden test: greet('Ada') must contain Ada.
labs.hint: A returned f-string can include name.
